name: deploy-service
description: Deploy a service with a rollback plan. APPROVAL REQUIRED before any deploy step.
steps: STOP: present the deploy plan plus rollback plan and get explicit approval
verify preconditions (image built, health checks defined) — abort if any fail
deploy to the named environment only, then verify health
on any health failure, roll back immediately and report
validation: deployment receipt plus post-deploy health status recorded
failure_recovery: automatic rollback on health failure; manual rollback command provided otherwise
cautions: APPROVAL REQUIRED: never deploy without explicit user approval
named environment only: never production unless production was named
never deploy with failing tests or missing rollback plan
never print registry credentials or deploy tokens
